definitions.audit_scope: independent raw measurement/matrix/statistics; shared read-only engagement/safety checks
definitions.completion_coverage: window-completed / all offered, not final verified / offered
definitions.conditional_p99: true when some offered LC requests never started; cannot establish protection
definitions.fidelity: paper-described scheduling component port; not author binary or full-system reproduction
definitions.goodput: verified < end divided by configured seconds; zero is retained
definitions.p99: nearest-rank arrival-to-verified over all started, including the late verified tail
definitions.slo: response <= frozen SLO AND verified < end; denominator is all offered LC requests

statistics.method: paired geometric ratios and arithmetic SLO percentage-point differences; whole-block percentile bootstrap
